page_title: NIC 1-2 PSG | Nice v PSG 15/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' It's a nice effort by Marco Asensio (PSG) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Marcin Bulka. Easy save.
90+2' Today's referee Ruddy Buquet rightly decides to book Pablo Rosario (Nice) for his harsh tackle.
90+2' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Nice fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
88' The resulting corner from Jeremie Boga (Nice) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
88' Evann Guessand (Nice) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Arnau Tenas.
86' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle after Carlos Soler (PSG) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
84' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
84' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Fabian Ruiz will be replaced by Carlos Soler (PSG).
83' The referee points to the corner flag and Nice will take a corner.
83' Antoine Mendy (Nice) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
82' It's time for a substitution. Romain Perraud (Nice) comes on in place of Khephren Thuram.
79' Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempts to test the goalkeeper after collecting a cross inside the penalty area. Luck doesn't appear to be on his side today as his attempt rattles the left post.
75' Melvin Bard (Nice) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
74' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' A loose ball is pounced on by Gaetan Laborde (Nice) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Arnau Tenas is alert and makes a comfortable save.
71' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Senny Mayulu (PSG) replacing Goncalo Ramos.
71' Substitution. Kang-In Lee leaves the pitch and is replaced by Marco Asensio (PSG).
70' Bradley Barcola (PSG) tries to find Fabian Ruiz, but he puts too much power on the pass.
68' Francesco Farioli prepares a substitution. Morgan Sanson is replaced by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Evann Guessand (Nice) is replacing Terem Moffi.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.
66' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' Jeremie Boga (Nice) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the right post.
58' Here is a change. Jordan Lotomba is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Mendy (Nice).
58' Substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho did his best and is replaced by Gaetan Laborde (Nice).
53' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
51' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle as Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
51' The PSG players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Bradley Barcola (PSG) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
46' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Vitinha (PSG) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45+1' Bradley Barcola (PSG) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Morgan Sanson (Nice) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
44' Bradley Barcola (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
43' Terem Moffi (Nice) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Milan Skriniar (PSG) brings an opponent down and Ruddy Buquet interrupts the game. Nice are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
39' PSG failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

39' A pass lands at the feet of Terem Moffi (Nice) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
38' Vitinha (PSG) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
33' Marquinhos (PSG) picks up a yellow card.
32' 1 - 2 Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the top right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
30' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
26' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
23' 0 - 2 Yoram Zague (PSG) receives a brilliant pass inside the box from Bradley Barcola, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:2.
20' Yoram Zague (PSG) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
18' 0 - 1 Bradley Barcola (PSG) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the right post.
16' The cross into the penalty area from Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
13' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Khephren Thuram (Nice) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' Kang-In Lee (PSG) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
8' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
6' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul.
3' Vitinha (PSG) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Marcin Bulka was alert and the score remains the same.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Ruddy Buquet is introduced as the referee for today's match.
